enunciado: For n = 8, 16, 32 and 64 count how many times the body of four typical loops runs: one that halves n (log n), a simple one (n), one that repeats the halving n times (n log n) and two nested ones (n²). Show a table.
objetivos: Count operations instead of measuring time
Recognize code patterns and their order of growth
pistas: When n doubles, log n adds 1, n doubles and n² quadruples.
A loop that does i = i * 2 runs log2(n) times.
Compare the columns row by row.
